scenes.title: ORDER BY
scenes.narration: ORDER BY sorts your query results, letting you present rows in a meaningful sequence.

scenes.title: Sorting results
bullets: Can sort by multiple columns in priority
scenes.narration: ORDER BY arranges rows in ascending order unless you specify otherwise. Adding DESC flips a column to descending, useful for showing the largest values first. You can list several columns so ties on the first are broken by the next.

scenes.title: Sorting by two columns
scenes.narration: This query sorts employees first by department in ascending alphabetical order. Within each department, the second key sorts salaries from highest to lowest. The result groups people by department while ranking earners inside each group.

scenes.title: When sorting happens
steps: LIMIT can then trim the top
scenes.narration: Sorting is one of the last steps, applied after rows are filtered and columns selected. ORDER BY then arranges those final rows by your chosen keys. A LIMIT clause, if present, can trim the sorted result to just the top rows.

scenes.text: ORDER BY turns an unordered result into a purposeful sequence, and it pairs naturally with LIMIT.
scenes.narration: Use ORDER BY to give your results a deliberate sequence, and combine it with LIMIT when you only need the top or bottom rows.
